benefits.text:
Inspired by mirror-glaze cakes, BBIA Over Glaze Stick gives lips a plump, alluring look with just one swipe.
Its unique moisturizing formula melts onto the lips, giving a refreshing cooling feel.
The thin, lightweight texture is non-sticky, so lips always feel comfortable.

howToUse.text: Twist up a suitable amount and apply evenly to the lips.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

sellingPoints.text: Glazed glow shine; moisturizing formula that melts onto the lips; thin, lightweight, non-sticky texture.

texture.text: Glossy balm in stick form, melts softly onto the lips.

positioning.text: Thin, lightweight glossy balm stick that creates a plump-looking lip effect, glossy like a glaze coating yet still comfortable.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Plump” is only a makeup effect on the lips, not actual lip plumping. The cooling feel may vary from person to person.
